acceptance: Evidence-led judgment: repeatable recall/F1/AP gains, high precision, individually inspected new FPs, exact untouched-concept parity and unchanged Job Fit logic. Historical global corpus regression only. Up to three serious candidates if enough unused support remains.
allocation: Validation allocation only after immutable candidate seal; second sample disjoint. No held-out texts, labels or classifier predictions inspected before seal. Broad lexical strata use user-supplied terminology, including ambiguous distractors; strata are not ground truth or detector predictions.
freshnessDefinition: Newly labeled and unreviewed for Virtualization, excluding prior full-taxonomy AI references by ID/description. Some text appeared in AI/CI-CD-specific prior work; not claimed never seen across all tasks.
limitations: Enriched available-cache sample; AI labels not human truth; same-model error correlation. All 83 cue-bearing fresh records support one discovery and two validation samples; any later round requires genuinely unreviewed data with adequate positives.
